New York Giants Extend Contracts of QB Jameis Winston and OL Jon Runyan

The New York Giants have agreed to two-year contract extensions with quarterback Jameis Winston and offensive lineman Jon Runyan. Sources indicate the deal with Winston is for two years, while Runyan's extension is reportedly worth $22 million. Both players are considered backups in their respective positions.
